propositions: The original substring containment check (`assert "pandoc.org" in text or "github.com/jgm/pandoc" in text`) accepts lookalike hosts (prefix-style like notpandoc.org, suffix-style like pandoc.org.evil.com) that do not actionably point at upstream.

The assertion must be replaced with a scheme+host-anchored regex using negative lookahead to enforce explicit end-of-host boundaries, rejecting both prefix and suffix lookalikes while accepting legitimate upstream URLs.

The new regex pattern `https?://(www\.)?pandoc\.org(?![\w.-])|https?://github\.com/jgm/pandoc(?![\w-])` uses `(?![\w.-])` after pandoc.org and `(?![\w-])` after the github path to prevent host spoofing.

The regex must reject `https://pandoc.org.evil.com`, `https://notpandoc.org`, and schemeless `pandoc.org` mentions, while still accepting the real NOTICE content and preserving the test's GPL source-availability intent.
